description: Who changed what in the workspace, newest first: people, API tokens and agents, with the changed fields and IP (Business plan). before.description: The next value of the previous page, for older entries.

resource_type.description: Only entries about this kind of thing, such as monitor, alert_channel, status_page, member or api_token.
